title: cerastium mutabile var. lanatum
intro: Cerastium mutabile var. lanatum, commonly known as woolly mouse-ear, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium mutabile var. lanatum include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
